dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: So, a short rest before the big battle, huh? In that case, I think some light-hearted music is in order.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Something easygoing enough to help everyone relax, but not to the point where it becomes too snoozeworthy.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Take a seat wherever you like! Once you're comfortable, Der Frühling and I shall begin our serenade.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: "When danger rose they overcame their foes, onward forging to the journey's end"...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #My dear, courageous {NICKNAME}, if you will allow this humble bard to join you on your journey, it would be my honor to compose an epic poem to remember your deeds.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I'm willing to bet a whole glass of Apple Cider that your story will be one for the ages!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: There's a lot of fascinating stories in these books.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Don't be put off by the dusty old pages. Give them a chance, and in the blink of an eye, these tales will waft into the air to the sound of the lyre, and blend into the sweetness of the breeze.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Pick a story you like! Let's try it out!
